name: Engaru (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Engaru town emblem in white: an outlined five-pointed star enclosing three interlocking rings.
history: Municipal flag of Engaru, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 2005.

features.role: Engaru town emblem — an outlined five-pointed star enclosing three interlocking rings
